components.name: TokenSwap
components.doc: Swap card with play money: two amount fields with token pickers, a flip button that makes the two fields trade places, live rate and fee rows, and a pending then confirmed state.

components.name: TokenSwapPreview
components.doc: Ready preview: the swap card centered on a quiet stage.

members.name: symbol
members.doc: Ticker, such as "ORB". Also the token's id.

members.name: name
members.doc: Full name, shown in the token menu.

members.name: price
members.doc: Price in US dollars. Rates between tokens derive from it.

members.name: tone
members.doc: Categorical tone of the token mark.

members.name: amount
members.doc: Amount paid, in the pay token.

members.name: received
members.doc: Amount received after the fee, in the receive token.

members.name: tokens
members.doc: Tokens offered in both pickers. Defaults to five made-up tokens.

members.name: defaultPay
members.doc: Symbol of the token paid at the start.

members.name: defaultReceive
members.doc: Symbol of the token received at the start.

members.name: amount
members.doc: Amount to pay, as typed. Pass it with `onAmountChange` to control the field.

members.name: onAmountChange
members.doc: Called with the cleaned text of the pay field whenever it changes.

members.name: feeRate
members.doc: Share of the paid amount kept as a fee. Defaults to 0.3%.

members.name: onSwap
members.doc: Runs when the person confirms. The card shows its pending state until the returned promise settles; without it, a short delay stands in.

members.name: container
members.doc: Render the token menus inside this element and keep them within it (used by the demo stage).
